name: Gym streaks
summary: A week of gym check-ins as a row of flames per person, with streaks, nudges for anyone who hasn't gone today, and the week's loser buying smoothies.
useWhen: a group keeping each other going to the gym, running or any daily habit
'did you go today', 'streak check', 'loser buys smoothies'
a weekly challenge in a chat
dontUseWhen: a one-off plan to go together (use a poll or a plan card)
ranking who's best at a game (use smash-elo)
a public challenge on a feed post (use public-challenge)

params.title: string
params.roast: one line of chat lore about the slacker
params.cheer: {name, text}: what someone said about your streak
params.people: {name, week: 0|1 per day Mon..today, before: streak carried in, nudge?: text}[]
